description: The book of a journal: every line of every posted entry over a period, in the order a book is read — day, journal, entry number, line — each with its entry, the document behind it, its account and its contact, and the totals of each journal at the head. Give journal_code for one journal (the sales journal, the bank); leave it out for the book of every journal, which on a real company is a lot of lines. For one account with its running balance, use general_ledger.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

journal_code.description: The journal to read, by its code, e.g. "SAL". Leave both out for the book of every journal.

journal_ids.description: The journals to read, by id.

name: journal_book
title: Journal book
